name: CPU sensor register layouts
copyright: Register layout data adapted from ZenStates-Core, LibreHardwareMonitor and GNR-SMU contributors.
notes: Exact table versions and bounded named fields only. GNR-SMU 0x620205/0x620105 mappings override the earlier unverified ZenStates candidates. Their per-core blocks also require family/model, core count and CoreId checks. EDC-live, FIT-as-frequency, ambiguous SVI3/VRM and L3 candidates are excluded. NCT6799D X670E-A board rails and temperature source routing follow the pinned motherboard profile; known-wrong Vcore/termination labels and unknown fan connector names are excluded. Granite Ridge d[83] is a SoC voltage setpoint, and unconfirmed d[18] is not exposed as a VID limit.
